vo.en: The loudest people are usually clueless.
vo.fr: Les plus bruyants sont souvent ignorants.

visual.description: A man shouting through a megaphone in a public space, appearing very confident.

vo.en: It’s called the Dunning-Kruger effect. A psychological glitch where having very little skill actually creates a massive surge of confidence.
vo.fr: C’est l’effet Dunning-Kruger. Un biais mental où le manque de compétence génère paradoxalement une confiance absolue.

visual.description: Abstract animation of glowing blue gears and neural connections inside a dark space.

vo.en: Beginners climb 'Mount Ignorant.' They don’t know enough yet to see their own gaps, so they feel like masters instantly.
vo.fr: Les débutants grimpent au 'Sommet de l'ignorance'. Ils ignorent leurs propres lacunes, ce qui leur donne l'illusion d'être experts.

visual.description: A man standing on top of a small rocky hill, looking out at a wide horizon with arms crossed.

vo.en: But once you start learning more, the reality hits. Your confidence crashes as you realize how deep the subject really goes.
vo.fr: Mais dès que tu apprends, la réalité frappe. Ta confiance s'effondre en découvrant la complexité du sujet.

visual.description: A man sitting at a desk covered in massive stacks of open books, looking overwhelmed and thoughtful.

vo.en: True experts actually doubt themselves. They assume that if a task is easy for them, it must be easy for everyone else too.
vo.fr: Les vrais experts, eux, doutent souvent. Ils pensent que si c’est facile pour eux, ça l’est pour tout le monde.

visual.description: Extreme close-up of a man's hands carefully repairing the tiny parts of a mechanical watch.

vo.en: Real wisdom, ce n'est pas d'avoir toutes les réponses. It’s the quiet ability to admit how much you still have to learn.
vo.fr: La sagesse, ce n'est pas d'avoir toutes les réponses. C’est avoir l’humilité d’admettre tout ce qu’il te reste à apprendre.

visual.description: A man looking through a large telescope at a vast, clear starry sky at night.

vo.en: So when you see total certainty, remember that...
vo.fr: Alors devant une certitude absolue, rappelle-toi que...

visual.description: A man walking away through a busy city crowd, disappearing into the motion.
